cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The hall rejected our wedding booking. I've decided we're meant for somewhere less municipal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every venue is full in June. Can we try September?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: September is approved. Three extra months to become an exemplary married couple.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: May I remind you my parents can't travel then?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reminder accepted. We'll go to them. Their garden is approved; this wedding has finally found the family it belongs with.

reason: Make B propose and question under A's approval hierarchy while each constraint redirects the same hopeful wedding plan.
